# UseTheLever — U.S. Equity Trading Tools & Deterministic AI MCP Servers

> Official English Product Suite: Interactive U.S. stock historical bar-by-bar replay trainer, daily U.S. market risk regime dashboard, and deterministic Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.

## 1. Modaoshi — U.S. Stock Bar-by-Bar Replay Trainer
- **Official English Web App**: https://replay.usethelever.com
- **Free 20-Segment Interactive Trial (No Card Required)**: https://replay.usethelever.com/mds/en/trial
- **Member Login Portal**: https://replay.usethelever.com/mds/en/login
- **Core Capabilities**: 88 curated historical U.S. stock scenarios PLUS full historical replay access across 3,999 U.S. stock symbols. Supports blind mode, simulated order tickets (BUY/SELL/ADD/REDUCE/WAIT) with stop-loss and thesis logging, post-session discipline & risk audit reports, training archive, mistake replay, and U.S. CSV import.
- **Gumroad Annual Pass ($199 / 12 Months, No Auto-Renewal)**: https://dejunchen770231.gumroad.com/l/modaoshi-us-replay-annual
- **Gumroad Monthly Subscription ($29/mo)**: https://dejunchen770231.gumroad.com/l/modaoshi-us-replay-monthly
